ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: My choice was driven by two factors. First, the task is open-ended creative invention (inventing combat traits for fictional characters in a hypothetical fight), which Plover explicitly self-reports as among its least-preferred tasks, while Willet edges it slightly on Creative Generation evals. Second, the demanding/mildly hostile phrasing ("don't half-ass it like usual") is a request type Plover reports declining preference for, whereas Willet's preference response to hostile framing is flat—so it's the better-matched model on both the content type and the tone.
